The travel budget available for the second half of the year is EUR 18,450. Commitments totaling EUR 10,780 already exist for approved registrations, booked tickets, and travel advances. The uncommitted balance is therefore EUR 7,670.

Five requests remain pending. Tomás's attendance at SIGIR is estimated at EUR 2,100 and is considered a priority because it is linked to the ARIADNA evaluation paper. Inés's trip to the VERDANT meeting would cost approximately EUR 1,350 and is included in the project plan. Mateo is requesting EUR 1,600 for a digital-heritage conference. The other two requests concern a technical course and an exploratory meeting without an associated deliverable.

The proposal is to provisionally approve SIGIR and the VERDANT meeting, reserve up to EUR 1,400 for Mateo, and request a cost reduction. Rosa will check for project-specific funds by 20 May. No additional booking should be confirmed until the balance has been updated with registrations already paid.
